name: Russian Empire

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of black, gold and white.
flag.symbolism: The colours were taken from the imperial coat of arms: a black double-headed eagle on a gold field, with white for the figure of Saint George.

hook: Imperial Russia ran black, gold, white from top to bottom, the Romanov heraldic colours; Germany's empire went black, white, red.
trivia: From 1896 the white-blue-red tricolour, which Russia flies again today, replaced it as the national flag.
Russian monarchist and nationalist groups still fly the black-gold-white flag.
